messages.en: I didn't get a chance to reply to your message earlier. I was in a meeting.
No worries, just reply when you're free. I wanted to confirm the time of tomorrow's meeting.

senses.en_definition: To help, assist or provide support.

messages.en: You've helped me so much this week. I definitely wouldn't have finished this work without you. Let me treat you to a meal tomorrow!
Anytime. We're friends, aren't we? It's no trouble. But if you're buying, I'm in!

senses.en_definition: To carry or transport something from one place to another.
To take, lead or accompany someone to a place.
To bring about or cause a particular result.
To involve someone or introduce something into a matter.

collocations.en: bring the family name into it

senses.en_definition: Up to; extending to a particular time or endpoint in a range.

collocations.en: from the evening into the night

senses.en_definition: To drive or ride a motor vehicle (colloquial).

messages.en: I'm about to head out. Is it raining where you are?
It's pouring here. Bring an umbrella too, or you'll get soaked.
Good thing you told me. I'll bring a big one so we can share.
I've got the file. I brought it to the office this morning.
Oh, great. Just leave it on my desk later, okay?
